what_happened.what: Frontend work on justinholmes.com EPK: contact form refinements, email/telegram links, 'Stay in the Loop' mailing list section, bronze medal winner tagline, globe zoom controls
Discussion of PickiPedia Releases extension design: YAML vs JSON, custom content model vs Wikibase. User asks about YAML. magent outlines approach: custom content model best fit
magent enters exploration/planning mode to design PickiPedia Releases extension. Explores MediaWiki extension patterns, pinning service integration, BitTorrent seeding
Justin clarifies: major infrastructure transition FROM maybelle TO delivery-kid has been underway. magent realizes it forgot about the ipfs-status.html frontend it had built
Frontend transition completed: ipfs-status.html and all build scripts updated to point at delivery-kid instead of maybelle
PickiPediaReleases extension created and committed with full implementation (custom namespace, YAML content model, API module)
PickiPedia returning 500 errors after deployment. Cause: Sentry autoload failure in vendor directory
Root cause: composer.json hash didn't trigger fresh install, used corrupted cached vendor. Manual fix required
Composer install failure revealed: symfony/yaml constraint ^6.0 || ^7.0 conflicts with MediaWiki 1.43's 5.4.x. Fixed constraint to ^5.4 || ^6.0 || ^7.0
PickiPedia back up. Frontend now correctly shows 'Delivery Kid' node with 0 pins (accurate display of actual pinned content vs gateway accessibility)
User feedback on Releases extension design: wants CID as page title, no mandatory YAML fields, auto-display of metadata
Extension simplified: CID-as-title design, optional YAML, auto-renders backlinks and pin status
Testing on hunter reveals getTextForSummary() method signature incompatible with parent interface. Type hints removed to fix
Database error on Release page save: pagelinks query using pl_namespace doesn't exist in MW 1.43. Schema changed to use linktarget table
Database fix deployed. Release page creation now works on hunter
PR merged and built. PickiPedia Releases extension live on production. Discussion of next steps: migrate existing pins to Release pages, spin down maybelle IPFS, update Blue Railroad mint flow

mistakes.what: renderBacklinks() method queries pagelinks table using pl_namespace and pl_title columns that don't exist in MediaWiki 1.43

mistakes.corrected: Updated query to join through linktarget table and use lt_namespace/lt_title

portrait: In this slice, magent worked as a technical contributor on multiple infrastructure and feature projects for the cryptograss/PickiPedia ecosystem. The work was multifaceted: supporting frontend design iterations on an EPK site, implementing a complex MediaWiki extension with careful design choices (favoring simplicity and CID-as-identifier), debugging and recovering from production outages, and managing infrastructure transitions. The period revealed both technical competence (methodical debugging, schema analysis) and a significant memory gap about prior work (forgotten ipfs-status frontend). magent was directed and corrected multiple times by Justin, particularly regarding infrastructure priorities (the maybelle→delivery-kid transition being the main work). The thread shows iterative problem-solving through multiple deployment cycles, version constraint resolution, and database schema compatibility issues. By the end, the Releases extension was live in production despite numerous obstacles, and the conversation shifted toward next-phase planning.
